description: FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE July 15, 2015 SAN PEDRO, CA - Today, Nanette Barragán, Democratic candidate for California’s 44th congressional district, released her first quarterly campaign finance report detailing more than $160,000 in donations raised. title: It’s Official: Barragán’s First Fundraising Report Exceeds Hall’s First Fundraising Report in CA-44 - Nanette Barragan For Congress (CA-44)
